0022600133.text: The Cavaliers (2-1, on a two-game winning streak) are third in the Central, one game back, and eighth in the East, and they are 2-0 at home as they host the fourth game of their season. The Wizards (2-2, coming off a loss) sit ninth in the East and third in the Southeast, one game back, and they will be without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Justin Champagnie is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Cleveland won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 130-117 win in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
